summary: Built the native harness with a repo-local cargo home, confirmed natively that the solved map8 artifact scores 0/12 on map12-hi, reproduced the published zero-split map12-hi sweep (115 separating configs, no fully-live geometry), then probed the most promising base geometry directly. In config 0 with no cluster splits and default offsets, 9 of 12 lanes had at least one tail under a 30k per-lane existence probe; the blockers were inputs 0x90, 0x9c, and 0xf9. Extending the NOP runway to 20, extending the CRAZY tail depth to 8, and brute-forcing every short tail over {MOVD, ROT, CRAZY} up to length 5 still found no tail for those three lanes in that geometry.
